**Decision: flipped `nmp-wallet` to `[[public_crates]]` now**, without waiting for Wave C.
 [...] 1. Read the actual gate scripts (`ci/check-release-manifest.sh`, `ci/release-package-dry-run.sh`) — `[[public_crates]]` classification only mechanically requires workspace-inherited `version`/`edition`/`license`/`repository`, a `description`, `publish != false`, and a passing `cargo package -p <crate> --list`. It gates packaging/consumability, not functional wiring. `nmp-wallet`'s `Cargo.toml` already satisfied every requirement — confirmed by a clean `cargo package -p nmp-wallet --allow-dirty --list`. [...] 2. Found precedent: `nmp-nip60` was un-parked into `[[public_crates]]` via #2865 while still Phase-0-only (no Cashu backend, no nutzap wiring) — so "public + pre-1.0/unstable + functionally incomplete" is already the established norm here.
3. On the ground, verified the issue's premise about `nmp-nip60` still being parked is stale — it's already public on master. [...] - `release/nmp-release.toml`: moved `nmp-wallet` from `[[private_packages]]` to `[[public_crates]]` (placed next to `nmp-nip60`), with an inline comment citing #2864/#2882/nutsack B1, stating pre-1.0/unstable status and git-rev-off-master pinning (reusing the existing pre-v1 compatibility language from `docs/architecture/external-consumers.md`), and noting Wave C is still pending.
